I can’t apply the fix because the workspace is read-only and approvals are disabled.

The exact one-line fix is in `test/orders.js`:

```js
for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
```

replacing:

```js
for (let i = 0; i <= items.length; i++) {
```

That fixes the crash by preventing `items[items.length]` from being accessed.
